title: Agent share-of-voice drop — hero SKU cited 11 vs competitor's 29
status_note: Decide · 5 of 8 approved · 7.5 of 8 weeks · readiness 61 → 84

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

checks.label: Canonical facts, single source
checks.note: Every approved item writes to the PIM and regenerates downstream.

checks.label: Machine-readable policy
checks.note: Returns, shipping and warranty publish as structured policy in wave 2.

checks.label: No synthetic specifications
checks.note: Enrichment draws on supplier sheets and existing GTIN records. Nothing is inferred or generated.

checks.label: Engineering capacity
checks.note: 7.5 of 8 weeks committed across two waves.

slate.name: Repair Walmart attribute mapping
slate.detail: The mapping broke nine days ago and took capacity, dimensions and heat rating with it. One repair closes all four mismatches and the highest-volume lost query in the battery.
slate.optionNote: Fixes the mapping at the source so every channel regenerates from one corrected field.

slate.name: Attribute enrichment · 12 hero SKUs, 26 fields
slate.detail: Every field shoppers constrained on in the battery — induction compatibility, oven-safe temperature, weight, handle material. Sourced from supplier spec sheets, nothing inferred.

slate.name: GTIN backfill · 43 variants
slate.detail: Without a GTIN a variant is invisible to two of the four surfaces regardless of how good its copy is. Codes exist on the supplier records already.

slate.name: Publish returns, shipping and warranty as policy schema
slate.detail: Satisfies the machine-readable policy lock from Reason and removes the third-party 14-day return answer. Human copy generates from the same record.

slate.name: Feed regeneration cadence · 12h → 2h
slate.detail: Closes most of the price-staleness gap. Paired with a rule that pulls a stale price rather than publishing it, which is what the accuracy floor actually requires.

slate.name: Schema coverage · Product, Offer, rating, policy on all PDPs
slate.detail: The single biggest share move and the only item that gets Google AI Mode to target. Template work across 1,240 PDPs, which is why it costs three weeks.

slate.name: Factual Q&A restructuring · 40 PDPs
slate.detail: Turns spec fields into question-shaped answers the surfaces can quote directly. Generated from PIM fields, so it cannot drift from the canonical record.

slate.name: Attribute enrichment · 180 long-tail SKUs
slate.detail: The same work as batch one across the tail. Lower share per week because these SKUs appear in fewer shopper constraints — worth doing, not worth doing first.
